phase_0_roadmap_consolidation.title: Roadmap consolidation
phase_0_roadmap_consolidation.summary: Collapse the useful parts of old roadmaps into one commercial roadmap, preserve historical lanes as folded or superseded, and keep repo boundaries explicit.

phase_1_pdd_project_gap_intake.title: PDD / Project Gap Intake
phase_1_pdd_project_gap_intake.summary: Ingest PDDs, monitoring reports, and workbooks into a project evidence inventory with page/section/fragment provenance and manual fragment-to-rule links.

phase_2_method_evidence_contracts.title: Method Evidence Contracts
phase_2_method_evidence_contracts.summary: Define expected evidence per rule in the methodologies repo so the app can distinguish missing evidence from unknown expectations.

phase_3_readiness_gap_engine.title: Readiness Gap Engine
phase_3_readiness_gap_engine.summary: Turn project evidence plus method expectations into rule-level gap states, severities, recommendations, and reviewer overrides.

phase_4_client_readiness_report_export.title: Client Readiness Report Export
phase_4_client_readiness_report_export.summary: Produce the paid readiness report and audit pack appendix for project developers and consultancies with explicit limits and traceability.

phase_5_vvb_workpaper_export.title: VVB Workpaper Export
phase_5_vvb_workpaper_export.summary: Reuse the same review data for VVB-facing draft workpapers, provenance bundles, and truthful registry-aware report sections.

phase_6_public_autopsy_workflow.title: Public Autopsy Workflow
phase_6_public_autopsy_workflow.summary: Create a public-safe autopsy workflow using public project documents, redactions, and source-tied findings for marketing and proof.

phase_7_white_label_pilot.title: White-label Consultancy Pilot
phase_7_white_label_pilot.summary: Let consultancies resell the readiness workflow under their own brand with a limited, manually assisted pilot.

phase_8_rule_encoding_sprint.title: Rule Encoding Sprint
phase_8_rule_encoding_sprint.summary: Make new methodology support repeatable by encoding rules, evidence expectations, and CI validation in the methodologies repo.

phase_9_pilot_sales_loop.title: Pilot Sales Loop
phase_9_pilot_sales_loop.summary: Turn readiness audits, white-label pilots, and VVB reviews into a repeatable sales loop with feedback flowing back into method contracts.
